description: Reusable OpenAPI and Swagger infrastructure for ASP.NET Core APIs.
Korzen Bot Protection for ASP.NET Core: asks Bot Protection about a request before a protected action, and fails open.
Typed real-time broadcasting over SignalR for Naravel: IBroadcastable events, channel authorization rules, signalr/log/null drivers and a test fake, built on Naravel.Foundation and Naravel.Events.
Named cache stores, tagging, scoping and locks for Naravel, built on Naravel.Foundation.
Memcached cache and lock providers for Naravel.Cache.
Redis cache and distributed-lock providers for Naravel.Cache.
Laravel-style query builder for Naravel on ADO.NET and Dapper: named connections on Naravel.Foundation, a connection and transaction seam that EF Core can share, and per-database driver packages.
EF Core interop for Naravel.Database: a DbContext and the query builder share one connection and one transaction.
MySQL driver for Naravel.Database, built on MySqlConnector.
PostgreSQL driver for Naravel.Database, built on Npgsql.
SQL Server driver for Naravel.Database, built on Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.
SQLite driver for Naravel.Database, built on Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.
A thin Encrypt/Decrypt facade over ASP.NET Core Data Protection. No custom cryptography: keys, rotation and persistence stay in Data Protection.
Typed event dispatcher with listener ordering, stop propagation, and optional queue adapter support.
Optional Naravel.Events adapter for running selected event listeners through Naravel.Queue.
Shared Manager -> Driver -> Factory Filesystem for Naravel modules (Laravel Illuminate\Support\Manager, reimagined for .NET).
Package Description
Typed mail contract for Naravel: Mailable classes, named transports (log, array, SMTP via an optional package) and a test fake, built on Naravel.Foundation.
Optional Naravel.Mail adapter that delivers mail through Naravel.Queue: QueueAsync stores only the built message data.
Optional SMTP transport for Naravel.Mail, built on MailKit.
Typed notification fan-out over explicitly named channels, with a fake for tests. Channels (Mail, Queue) are separate opt-in packages.
Optional Naravel.Notifications adapter: a "mail" channel that delivers a notification through Naravel.Mail.
Optional Naravel.Notifications adapter that delivers notifications through Naravel.Queue: only a registered alias and a plain payload are stored.
Laravel-style pagination results for .NET: length-aware, simple and cursor pages with Laravel's data/links/meta JSON. No EF Core, ASP.NET Core or database dependency.

PaginateAsync, SimplePaginateAsync and CursorPaginateAsync for EF Core queries, returning Naravel.Pagination results. Keyset (cursor) paging applies both the order and the filter from one key declaration.

A Laravel-inspired, driver-based background job queue for .NET. Dispatch, retry with backoff, chaining, batching and a background worker - core package (add Naravel.Queue.Memory for the in-process driver, or Naravel.Queue.Redis/.File/.Database/.RabbitMQ/.Kafka for other backends).
Optional Naravel.Queue job middleware that coordinates workers through Naravel.Cache locks and rate limits: WithoutOverlapping, RateLimited and ThrottlesExceptions.
EF Core-backed queue driver for Naravel.Queue - works with any EF Core provider (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL).
Optional Naravel.Queue adapter that encrypts the payload of jobs marked IShouldBeEncrypted with ASP.NET Core Data Protection. Unmarked jobs keep the existing wire format.
File-based queue driver for Naravel.Queue - durable, zero external services required, JSON files on disk.
Kafka queue driver for Naravel.Queue, built on Confluent.Kafka - semantics adapted for a log-based broker (see class docs for details).
In-process "memory" queue driver for Naravel.Queue - zero dependencies, ideal for tests and local development.
RabbitMQ queue driver for Naravel.Queue - delayed jobs via per-message TTL + dead-lettering, no plugin required.
Redis queue driver for Naravel.Queue, built on StackExchange.Redis - priority buckets, delayed jobs and automatic reclaim of jobs left behind by a crashed worker.
Named, shared Redis connections for Naravel modules: one StackExchange.Redis multiplexer per name, owned and disposed by one manager.

Laravel-style routing and middleware for ASP.NET Core: fluent route groups, named routes, route model binding, resource routes and a middleware engine with aliases, groups, parameters, priority, withoutMiddleware and terminable middleware.
Naravel task scheduling: a fluent, named schedule run by a hosted service, with overlap and one-server guards over Naravel.Cache locks.
